synthesis.value_reasoning: CRITICAL DATA ERROR: All competitor data collected is for BODY WAXING services, NOT auto detailing/car wash services. The deal is for "exterior wash and wax packages" for vehicles (sedans, SUVs, trucks) but every competitor source scraped is for human body waxing (Brazilian waxes, bikini waxing, facial waxing). The category context validates "$30–$60" as typical for "waxing services in Orlando" — again referring to body waxing, not car care. No valid auto detailing competitor pricing was collected. Without legitimate comparable data, the Groupon price of $76 for sedan exterior detail cannot be meaningfully compared to market rates. The data quality report incorrectly flags the price as "ABOVE the validated market range" because it's comparing car detailing to body waxing services. This is a fundamental research failure — all pricing comparisons are invalid.
